name: AI Probe (research)
description: Research: do the sentries' AI records (perception and behaviour) also run the enemies, and can they be made to lose you? Shift+F7 surveys the enemies within 60 m, F7 watches how many are after you for 15 s, Ctrl+F7 tries hiding you from them for 10 s. Alt+F7 traces patrols' navigation records for 30 s; Shift+Alt+F7 tries sending the patrols near you 80 m to your side. Host or solo. Turn off when done.
